name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/site-excalidraw
description: Embeds the vault's Excalidraw drawings as their exported light and dark SVGs, and keeps the drawings' own notes off the site. Vendored, for testing, from dinolupo/quartz-excalidraw and ported to Quartz 5. A site plugin: a repo-only package, never published (private), loaded by package name like every other plugin of ours. See CONTEXT.md.
//files: Repo-only (private), so never packed or published; files, license, publishConfig and repository are here because the package contract is one shape for every plugin of ours (#98).
//exports: Every entry has its type declarations beside it, which build.mjs emits, as every plugin of ours does: the package contract (the package-contract repo guard, #98) holds a site plugin to the same shape as a published one. ./package.json is how Quartz reads the manifest (import.meta.resolve).
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copies, never bundled or installed here. The types are imported for types only; @quartz-community/utils slugifies the exports' paths as Quartz's asset emitter does.
//devDependencies: Build-time only: esbuild bundles dist/, and @chaoticgoodcomputing/declarations writes dist/index.d.ts (build.mjs).

quartz.name: site-excalidraw
quartz.description: Embeds Excalidraw drawings as their exported SVGs, and unpublishes the drawings' notes.
quartz.//defaultOrder: Below obsidian-flavored-markdown's 30, so a drawing's embed is rewritten before OFM reads it as a transclusion.
